primary_sources.exact_import: Limit mixed-Hodge morphisms are strict for their actual weight M. The connecting map of N complexes targets L(-1), pure weight6, so the invariant-vector bound kills the lower original-weight invariant contribution. No M=W assertion is made generally.

new_written_arguments: The intrinsic rational coinvariant class xi=[d] exists before semisimplicity and purity. It vanishes iff a rational fixed ambient lift exists; its dual connecting delta is nonzero iff the ambient line lies in image N.

Geometric limit exactness follows from canonical flat-extension exactness, preservation of limiting F, relative-filtration functoriality and ordinary mixed Hodge strictness. This explicitly avoids the nonabelian limit-data category trap.
If original weights of a relatively filtered nilpotent space are<=b, then every invariant vector lies in M_b by injectivity of N on higher M grades. For K=H2(F)(-1), invariants in W5 thus lie in M5.

The connecting delta:ker N_K -> Q(-3) kills all W5 invariants and factors through J=image(original1 invariants -> GrW6 K), a Tate subspace that need not equal the full graph space. This is valid with arbitrary fibre1 Jordan blocks.

When xi0, the actual projected Haar lift differs from a fixed lift by a canonical residual beta in F1/ker(A-I). Eventual-pure all-marker safety iff beta0. This quotient by fixed cycles is not the coinvariant quotient by image(A-I).

Cyclic coinvariants of every polynomial branch are isomorphic to primitive coinvariants by summing transported branches. The common-loop formula sends composite xi EXACTLY to the tuple of primitive xi, without semisimplicity, purity, extra multiplicity or cancellation.

For EVERY fixed f, a finite intrinsic bad-puncture set controls the intrinsic extension of every H(f). Meeting it certifies eventual-pure failure; avoiding it still leaves residual Haar motion in nonsemisimple cases.
essential_boundaries: BOTH full exceptional MZ cases remain OPEN. Neither intrinsic delta_J nor residual beta is universally killed or realized by an exceptional failure.
The general Tate factor is for the INTRINSIC COINVARIANT extension class, not all actual fibre motion. J is the IMAGE of local invariants in the top Tate weight, not the whole top weight.
Zero intrinsic class gives a rational fixed lift, not an integral fixed lift or actual Haar invariance. Residual beta remains whenever fibre1 is nonsemisimple.
The new quotient-level transfer has factor1; the old semisimple fixed-vector1/e rule remains correct because e branch components sum to the primitive class.

No purity reflection to primitive f, full-resolvent algebraicity shortcut, arbitrary-ring topological promotion, general MHS/lattice/cycle producer, universal machine verification, new search or review gate.
